usage: caelestia shell [-h] [-d] [-r] [-s] [-l] [-k] [--log-rules RULES]
                       [message ...]

positional arguments:
  message            a message to send to the shell

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  -d, --daemon       start the shell detached
  -r, --restart      kill and restart the shell
  -s, --show         print all shell IPC commands
  -l, --log          print the shell log
  -k, --kill         kill the shell
  --log-rules RULES  log rules to apply
